### The Power of Riches
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-power-of-riches
Passage: Mark 10:21
Points:
- The young man mistakenly believed he could earn eternal life through personal righteousness.
- Jesus pointed him to the commandments to expose his flawed view of law-keeping.
- By instructing him to sell everything, Jesus identified wealth as the man's primary idol.
- The man walked away in grief because he loved earthly riches more than God.
- Believers must guard their hearts against materialism and treasure eternal life in Christ above all.

### Lord, All I Have Is Yours
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/lord-all-i-have-is-yours
Passage: Mark 10:21
Points:
- Outward morality, earnestness, and material blessings can mask an absence of genuine saving faith.
- Jesus lovingly challenged the young man to uncover what he truly trusted and treasured.
- Living in material prosperity makes trusting God particularly deceptive and spiritually dangerous.
- It often requires greater faith to surrender material security than to trust God in scarcity.
- Disciples must willingly submit all possessions, security, and futures entirely to Christ.
